description: The SafeMap coastal-inundation service provides storm-surge scenario mapping for coastal disaster planning. The metadata describes west and south coast coverage and distinguishes this product from inland drainage and river-flood maps. The resource is documented by Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Republic of Korea. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: Use permitted without restrictions, as stated by the national metadata page. Access is described as free. Resource access is registration. The page mixes a 100-year description with a 50-200-year scenario range. These are scenario hazard maps, not current typhoon forecasts. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
